mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.account_group_id AS groupId, a.dispatched_at AS dispatchedAt, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState, g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AS marketingTaskId, a.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN account_group g ON g.id = a.account_group_id AND g.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id IN ORDER BY a.id

SELECT d.account_id AS accountId, b.import_format AS importFormat, b.device_os AS deviceOs, d.raw_payload AS rawPayload FROM account_import_detail d JOIN account_import_batch b ON b.id = d.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.parse_result = 1 AND d.account_id IN ORDER BY d.account_id, d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_export_job (id, tenant_id, created_by, status, account_ids_json, account_count, filename, sha256, file_size, archive, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{status}, #{accountIdsJson}, #{accountCount}, #{filename}, #{sha256}, #{fileSize}, #{archive}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO account_export_item (job_id, account_id, previous_state) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{row.id}, #{row.accountState})
mapper.sql: a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.dispatched_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_group ag WHERE ag.id = a.account_group_id AND ag.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ag.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_pull_marketing_task bt WHERE bt.builder_group_id = a.account_group_id AND bt.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND bt.resource_status IN (2, 3))
